g.text: C4-L1 Container Diagram — SkillSwap (C4 standard Level 2)
Current implementation: booking screens use local data and PaymentGateway is backed by a mock adapter; no provider is selected.
Backend signs classroom invitations and document upload links locally. No network call to Jitsi/MinIO is implied.
HTTP labels describe local development; production ingress is HTTPS. Only status calls are connected from the web app.
